### Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO amid leadership and political scrutiny
Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia CEO, with reports indicating he is weighing a potential return to the role. The transition has sparked internal employee petitions, calls for leadership changes from US officials, and media coverage of his management style and the company's political challenges. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/14/where-was-nvidias-security-team/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/shaky-espionage-case-may-not-save-jensen-huang-nvidia-job-2026-11), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/thousands-nvidia-staff-sign-petition-bring-back-huang), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261114/p22#a261114p22))

### US tightens AI chip export controls and addresses Nvidia-China scandal
In response to the Nvidia scandal involving chip smuggling to China, the US government and allies are implementing stricter export rules and bipartisan efforts to restrict Chinese access to advanced AI technology. These measures include new legislation, diplomatic actions, and investigations into how Nvidia exploited sanction gaps. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261114/p23#a261114p23), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p1#a261115p1), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.wsj.com/tech/jensen-huang-backdoor-ai-data-centers-a5e4499d), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/bipartisan-lawmakers-china-ai-chip-export-controls-3809776))

### Megaspeed retains counsel to probe AI cloud reports
Megaspeed, a firm linked to Jensen Huang's former partner, retained external legal counsel to investigate reports regarding its AI cloud business and alleged chip orders for China. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/megaspeed-retains-counsel-to-probe-reports-on-its-ai-cloud-business/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/firm-linked-to-jensen-huangs-ex-lover-reportedly-brokered-nearly-12-billion-in-nvidia-chip-orders-for-china/))

### Apple plans to unveil smart glasses at WWDC
Apple is expected to unveil smart glasses at WWDC and ship them by the end of 2027, with a focus on integrating third-party iPhone apps with Siri AI. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-11-15/apple-siri-ai-app-integrations-power-smart-glasses-iphone-duo-2-face-id-plan), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p10#a261115p10), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1033968/apples-first-smart-glasses-are-coming-together))

### South Korea top tax exam scorer admits AI cheating
The top scorer in South Korea's national tax accountant qualification exams admitted to using generative AI to answer questions, raising concerns for upcoming national college entrance exams. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2026/11/15/3AYAGNRWENBAJISSMVP6HZQZ3E/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-15/korea-s-top-scorer-in-tax-accountant-exam-admits-to-ai-cheating), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/15/ai-cheating-south-korea-college-entrance-exam), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/top-scorer-south-korean-tax-exam-confesses-cheating-with-ai-2026-11-15/))
